case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for the clear overview of the terms. We value the long-standing cooperation with Ravensteiner and would like to secure our seal supply on a solid footing.

Our data shows a different picture from the offer:

Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

With that in mind, we have built our proposal around the planning security and contract stability that matter to a supplier in your position. A larger binding volume and a longer term give you reliable planning, and we ask in return for a shorter lead time and a price in line with our order history.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 42 days.

We look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Your historical data is noted, but past pricing does not govern current agreements. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We accept the binding volume of 23,400 units and the 24-month contract term.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer presents a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. It stays valid for 7 days. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, in trade, we require the lead time to remain at 54 days, yielding a revised price of EUR 31.90, under an alternative package of a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your clear reply and for checking the data we shared. We understand your position on pricing and appreciate the candour.

We are glad to take up your alternative package, as you offered it. It gives both sides planning security through a binding volume and a longer contract term.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.90; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 56 days.

We look forward to confirming this with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your agreement to the unit price of EUR 31.90 and the revised lead time of 56 days. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. We accept this package, and the negotiation is hereby concluded. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our offer remains valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
